evidence.description: Confirm the RERA number is genuine and active on the official MahaRERA portal — “RERA applied” or “registration in process” is not valid. Review the developer's past and ongoing projects, completion dates, and any complaints or litigation listed against them. Check that approved plans and layouts on the portal match what the sales team shows you. Ensure multi-phase projects have each phase registered separately, and that your unit falls under a registered phase. Read the quarterly financial and construction-progress updates RERA requires developers to file. Insist the Agreement for Sale follows the RERA format — stating carpet area, total cost and a firm possession date. Source: MahaRERA • IGR Maharashtra ## Buying in Andheri East: Pros & Trade-offs Pros [...] How do I verify a developer or project before booking? Search the official MahaRERA portal for the project, confirm the registration number is active, review the developer’s other projects and any complaints, and ensure approved plans match what you are shown. Never rely on a brochure or PDF alone. What does a RERA registration number guarantee? It confirms the project is legally registered with regulatory disclosures on timelines, approvals and finances. By law, any project over 500 sq.m or with more than 8 units must be registered before it can be marketed or sold. Should I buy under-construction or ready-to-move in Andheri East?
